edits.head: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated reusable 2D puppet HEAD base layer. Edit target: the attached existing frog wizard portrait, preserve its exact cartoon design and chunky curved ink style. Remove the hat, scarf, torso, arms and hands completely. Remove the eyes, eyelid lines, pupils, mouth and nostril marks: those will be separate animation layers. Reconstruct the head underneath those features and under the hat and hands. Output ONLY a complete bald, blank teal frog head silhouette, with two gently rounded eye bulges at the top, broad friendly cheeks and rounded chin, matching the proportions of this frog. The empty facial surface is uninterrupted muted teal (#548f99 approximately), with just one broad darker teal shadow along the lower-right cheek/chin. Thick smooth near-black plum (#231f25) outer ink. Flat vector-friendly solid color shapes, no gradients, texture, lighting or extra detail. Centered with generous transparent padding on a genuinely transparent background, no labels, no detached pieces, no facial features. This is a clean underlying head plate for reassembling the exact reference frog, not a new character.
edits.costume: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean underlying costume layer for a layered 2D frog wizard puppet. Edit target: attached approved portrait. Output ONLY the complete headless torso/costume: same plum scarf/cowl, same broad shoulders, same little gold diamond brooch at viewer-left chest. Remove the head, hat, face, BOTH hands and all teal arms entirely. Reconstruct the scarf folds that were hidden behind the clasped hands; a continuous natural full cowl fabric surface must occupy their previous area, without hand-shaped patches or gaps. Keep the original rounded shoulder outline, flat-cut bottom edge, simple sweeping curved fabric folds, brooch position and chunky near-black plum ink style. A short dark collar opening at the top may be filled dark for the head to overlap. Same muted plum, dusty violet, cream/gold palette; flat solid cel color shapes, no textures/gradients. Genuinely transparent background, generous padding. This is an image-to-image separation/cleanup of the existing costume, not a redesign. No head, eyes, hat, hands, limbs, labels or extra accessories.

Output just ONE connected isolated hand with short forearm on true transparent background with generous padding. Preserve the hand's original diagonal orientation and proportions. No labels, no other pieces.
